claims.evidence: Witness report shows LUMIX brand but model is null; top plate and charger do not reveal G7.
Photos show body and lens but not wear or cosmetic condition.
Photo 1 shows one LUMIX battery and a charger; a second battery is not shown.
Photos cannot show the seller's location.
Shutter count is not shown in photos and is listed as not shown by the witness.

claims.claim: no fungus or scratch on the lens
claims.evidence: Lens glass condition is not shown in photos.
Photo 1 shows LUMIX battery and charger but originality cannot be confirmed.
Repair history is not shown in photos.

risks.risk: Camera does not turn on or functions fail
risks.proof: Video of camera powering on, navigating menus, taking and reviewing a photo

risks.risk: High shutter count or heavy usage
risks.proof: Screenshot of menu showing shutter count
Photo of the sensor with lens removed, or a shot of a plain wall to reveal sensor spots

risks.risk: Lens glass has scratches, fungus, or haze
risks.proof: Close-up clip of front and rear lens elements under light
Video of camera running on battery for an extended period
Video of charger charging a battery with indicator light on

risks.risk: Missing accessories such as caps, strap, box, manuals, or second battery
risks.proof: Photo of all claimed accessories together
Close-up of body seams, screw heads, and any repair marks

proof_requests: Clear photo of the top plate showing the model number
Video of the camera turning on, focusing, and taking a photo
Close-up of the lens front and rear glass under light
Photo of both batteries, charger, caps, strap, and box together
response.reason: The witness confirms a LUMIX mirrorless camera but could not read the model, and the seller's model, condition, shutter count, and accessory claims cannot be verified from the photos, so even a worst-case price cannot be set without proof of model and function.
